newsitem.title: UK: RMC bucks weak market on corrective buying.
newsitem.headline: RMC bucks weak market on corrective buying.

text.p: Shares in building materials supplier RMC Group Plc bucked the weak stock market on Monday as investors sought to remedy oversold positions, dealers said.
RMC shares were up 10p or 0.88 percent at 1,137p by 1306 GMT, while the FTSE 100 share index was down almost one percent. Some 376,000 shares had changed hands.
"RMC took a bit of a bashing after the figures last week and the market got caught a bit short...volumes aren't particularly big and it's mostly between professionals," one dealer said.
RMC shares dropped sharply last week after the company warned full-year results would not match 1995.
The company also reported a 26.5 percent fall in first-half pretax profits, in line with expectations.
